text.$description: WhatsApp button label: 6.7:1 on the base

caption.$description: 11 px: uppercase eyebrows and badges only

meta.$description: 12 px: meta text, timestamps, helper text

stat.$description: 24 px: stat values and metric numbers

tight.$description: Only for text 20 px and larger

sm.$description: Phones: single column below this width

md.$description: Navigation rail becomes a top bar and drawer below this width

lg.$description: Optional side panes collapse below this width

surface-subtle.$description: Low-emphasis surface that gently separates content

agent-working.$description: Agent thinking, streaming, and execution state

agent-waiting.$description: Agent waiting for input or approval

decorative-highlight.$description: Optional decorative highlight only; never use for status, focus, or body text

overlay-backdrop.$description: Scrim behind modal dialogs and drawers

inverse-surface.$description: Surface on an inverse marketing canvas

inverse-surface-muted.$description: Muted surface on an inverse marketing canvas

inverse-text.$description: Primary text on an inverse marketing canvas

inverse-text-muted.$description: Secondary text on an inverse marketing canvas

inverse-border.$description: Border on an inverse marketing canvas

status-warning-accent.$description: Warning stripes and dots, never text

overlay-hover.$description: Translucent hover wash over any surface

font-size-stat.$description: 24 px stat values (was font-size-display before the marketing scale)

action-appearance.$description: Default Button appearance for this brand: solid or depth. Read by @brandcloud/ui and @brandcloud/astro

action-depth-from.$description: Depth button: top stop of the body gradient (lighter)

action-depth-to.$description: Depth button: bottom stop of the body gradient (deeper, same hue)

action-depth-glow.$description: Depth button: light rising inside from the bottom edge (same hue family); transparent unless a brand sets it

action-depth-glow-reach.$description: Depth button: vertical reach of the inner glow; above 30% the label loses AA contrast

action-depth-sheen.$description: Depth button: thin top sheen over the upper half

action-depth-rim.$description: Depth button: bright inner rim (inset box-shadow)

action-depth-fill.$value: radial-gradient(65.28% var(--brand-action-depth-glow-reach) at 50% 100%, var(--brand-action-depth-glow), transparent), linear-gradient(var(--brand-action-depth-from), var(--brand-action-depth-to))
action-depth-fill.$description: Depth button body: background-image built from the depth tokens

shadow-action-depth.$description: Depth button: contact shadow plus same-hue glow underneath

shadow-action-depth-hover.$description: Depth button hover: stronger same-hue glow
